# Voca - Full Documentation

> Free, open-source desktop app that transcribes your voice with AI corrections and translates into 100+ languages.

Voca is a cross-platform desktop application for macOS and Windows built for developers and professionals who want to dictate text faster than typing. Press a global keyboard shortcut from any app, speak, and the AI-corrected transcript is automatically pasted where your cursor was - no switching windows, no copy-pasting.

The project is fully open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/emircan-sahin/voca

---

## How It Works

1. Press the global keyboard shortcut (configurable)
2. Speak - Voca records your microphone
3. Audio is sent to our cloud pipeline
4. Background noise is removed
5. Deepgram Nova-3 or Groq Whisper transcribes the audio
6. xAI Grok corrects and improves the text
7. The result is auto-pasted where your cursor was

No manual copy-paste. No switching apps. The transcript appears instantly in whatever app you were using.

---

## Key Features

- Global keyboard shortcut - works from any app on macOS and Windows
- AI-corrected transcription - fixes grammar, improves wording, removes filler words
- Auto-paste to cursor position - result lands exactly where you left off
- Developer Mode - recognizes code terms, function names, library names, and technical jargon
- 100+ language translation with tone control (casual, formal, developer)
- Background noise cancellation - built for real-world environments
- Deepgram Nova-3 and Groq Whisper STT engines
- Numeric add-on - dictate numbers and they are formatted correctly
- Planning add-on - structures spoken ideas into organized notes
- Open source under MIT license - inspect every line of code

---

## Speech Recognition

- Engine options: Deepgram Nova-3, Groq Whisper
- 35+ supported languages for speech recognition
- Languages include: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Turkish, Arabic, and many more

---

## Translation

- Powered by xAI Grok
- 100+ languages supported
- Tone options: Casual, Formal, Developer
- Developer mode keeps code terms in English while translating the rest naturally

---

## Pricing

Voca is completely free. No plans, no card.

- Every feature included
- Groq and Deepgram STT engines
- AI tone and translation
- Numeric and Planning add-ons
- Personal vocabulary for names and terms
- Push-to-talk and hold-to-talk shortcuts
- Transcript history
- Privacy mode

We may add paid features in the future. Changes will be announced in advance and nobody is charged retroactively.

---

## Privacy and Data

- Audio is recorded only while the shortcut is held or toggled, sent to the chosen STT provider (Groq or Deepgram), and deleted from our server right after transcription
- If translation is on, the transcript text is sent to xAI (Grok); xAI never receives audio
- Transcripts are saved to History by default and can be deleted any time; Privacy Mode never saves them on our servers
- The desktop app has no analytics; the usevoca.dev website uses Google Analytics for visit statistics
- No selling data, no ads
- Full source code is available for audit: https://github.com/emircan-sahin/voca
- Authentication via Google OAuth (Google account required)
- Full policy: https://usevoca.dev/privacy

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Voca free?
Yes, Voca is completely free. No plans, no card. Download it and every feature is yours. It is also open source, so you can read every line of code yourself.

### Do I need to pay or add a card?
No. You sign in with Google and start talking. We do not ask for a card or any payment details.

### What makes Voca different?
Background noise cancellation built for real-world environments. AI that recognizes function names, code terms, and technical jargon. Smart auto-paste that lands the corrected transcript right where your cursor was. No copy-paste, no switching apps.

### What is Developer Mode?
Developer Mode is a tone setting for software engineers. When enabled, Voca's AI recognizes code terms, function names, library names, and technical jargon and transcribes them correctly. Say "reakt use state hook" and it writes "React useState hook".

### Which languages are supported?
35+ languages for speech recognition through Deepgram and Groq. 100+ languages for AI-powered translation with tone control.

### Where is my data stored?
Audio is deleted from our server right after transcription. Transcripts are saved to your History unless you turn on Privacy Mode in Settings, which never saves them on our servers. Voca is fully open source, so you can inspect every line of code yourself.

### Does it work offline?
No. Voca requires an internet connection. Audio is processed in our cloud pipeline for the best quality at the lowest cost.

### Will new features be added?
Yes. Voca is actively developed and ships updates regularly. Your feedback directly shapes the roadmap.
